execution: one fresh Python kernel per notebook; cells in document order; stop after first error or timeout
parameters: one parameters-tagged cell of simple name=literal assignments, override only existing names; JSON scalar values
display_id: updates apply to all previously displayed outputs for that display_id in this kernel run, even outputs in earlier cells
stdin: unsupported and should fail the cell explicitly
source_policy: source notebooks read-only; clear old execution_count and code outputs in result before run
